prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were mostly too high for neutral or negative changes, but too low for winning tests.
Sign-in reorder changes were helpful in 2 tests, while 2 tests showed no clear effect.
Adoption redesign changes showed no clear effect in 2 tests and made performance worse in 2 tests.
No clear effect was seen for home new_flow changes across 2 tests.
Finish new_screen changes made performance worse in 1 test and showed no clear effect in 1 test.
Evidence is still thin for choose_path reorder and sign_in notification (1 test each), while adoption new_flow had mixed results across 2 tests (1 worse, 1 won).

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: +1.8% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- adoption, redesign: -4.2% after noise correction, 4 test(s)
- choose_path, reorder: +0.9% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: -2.0% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- home, new_flow: -2.3% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- sign_in, notification: +8.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: +2.2% after noise correction, 4 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 86.6%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 71.7%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 24.9%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] System Tray Quick Access Screen: Adds a dedicated onboarding screen after home_intro demonstrating how to access pet controls via system tray shortcuts. (why: 3 support emails reported post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control, hide, or talk to the pet.)
1: [home, new_flow] Interactive Companion Activity Flow: Adds mini trait interaction cards on the waiting screen allowing users to pick companion habits while pet rendering completes. (why: Waiting screen in home step has an extreme mean duration of 2336s.)
2: [choose_path, redesign] Story Screen Visual Narrative Redesign: Redesigns the story screen using a dynamic split view layout highlighting the world of desktop pets. (why: choose_path step has a mean duration of 514s and 76.2% conversion rate.)
3: [sign_in, copy] Account Protection Benefit Copy: Replaces sign-in headline and body copy to clearly explain cloud sync protection for created pets. (why: 8 support emails reported lost or reset pets after re-authenticating.)
4: [home, wait_info] Pet Generation Countdown Wait Info: Displays dynamic estimated remaining time and generation phase updates on the waiting screen. (why: The waiting screen has an average wait time of 2336s, leading to drop-offs.)
5: [finish, notification] Desktop Tray Icon Reminder Notification: Triggers a notification banner on home_intro reminding users where pet control tools are located. (why: 3 support emails reported post-onboarding confusion on how to control or hide pets.)
6: [adoption, incentive] Adoption Certificate Mascot Incentive: Adds a celebratory animated mascot badge to the adoption_certificate screen as users complete naming. (why: Adoption conversion is 71.7% and takes 89s median.)
7: [adoption, layout] Pick Friend Character Spotlight Layout: Changes the pick_friend screen layout to a centered spotlight preview showcasing individual pet animations. (why: Adoption step drops nearly 28.3% of users during pet selection and photo upload.)

scores.note: finish new_screen changes historically performed poorly (-2.0%) despite support mail evidence.
home new_flow changes showed negative results (-2.3%) across previous tests.
Redesign changes generally perform poorly or show no clear benefit.
High evidence from 8 support emails and low cost copy change.
Wait info helps set user expectations on long wait step.
Targeted notification addressing 3 support emails on post-onboarding confusion.
Minor celebratory UI additions on high-drop adoption step.
Adoption redesign layout changes previously degraded performance (-4.2%).
